title: Membership Tenure and Marlowe Rewards Goodwill: Training Questions
content:
**Does the length of a Marlowe Rewards membership affect a service goodwill grant?**
Yes. A membership-tenure uplift applies, based on the whole calendar months from the enrolment date to the posting date.

**What are the steps?**

| Whole calendar months from enrolment to the posting date | Membership-tenure uplift |
|---|---|
| 96 or more | 20 percent |
| 48 to 95 | 10 percent |
| under 48 | none |

**What is the uplift a percentage of?**
It is a percentage of the grant's starting figure. It is added to the grant before the grant is rounded and limited.

**Where does the count start?**
On the enrolment date on the membership record. Only whole calendar months count.

**Boundary cases (hypothetical member enrolled 15 March 2017).**

| Posting date | Whole calendar months | Uplift |
|---|---|---|
| 15 March 2025 | 96 | 20 percent |
| 14 March 2025 | 95 | 10 percent |
| 15 March 2021 | 48 | 10 percent |
| 14 March 2021 | 47 | none |

**Illustration.**
On a hypothetical starting figure of 150 points, 20 percent adds 30 points and 10 percent adds 15 points.
